name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: Panes the user resizes by dragging or with the keyboard: a group of panels with focusable separator handles between them (ARIA window splitter).
usage: Use Resizable for an app layout whose panes the user sizes: DBee's sidebar beside the editor, the editor above the results. Compose Resizable (orientation) > ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel …; panels and handles are direct children; nest a vertical group inside a panel for a grid of panes. Sizes are percentages: defaultSize, minSize, maxSize per panel, or sizes and onSizesChange on the group to persist them. collapsible lets Enter on the handle collapse the panel before it. Give the group a sized parent (it fills it). For a fixed rule between sections use Separator; for a collapsible app sidebar with an icon rail use Sidebar.

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal: panels side by side; vertical: stacked.

props.name: onSizesChange
props.description: Called with the new sizes while dragging or pressing keys.

props.name: keyboardStep
props.description: Percent an arrow key moves a handle.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The group, a flex row or column filling its parent; data-slot="resizable", data-orientation.

slots.name: panel
slots.description: A pane sized by flex basis; data-slot="resizable-panel", data-collapsed.

slots.name: handle
slots.description: role="separator", a border.width.1 rule with a size.track hit area on each side; data-slot="resizable-handle", data-orientation, data-dragging, data-disabled.

slots.name: grip
slots.description: The optional grip in the middle of the rule; data-slot="resizable-grip".

parts.name: ResizablePanel
parts.description: One pane: defaultSize, minSize, maxSize, collapsible, collapsedSize (percent).

parts.name: ResizableHandle
parts.description: The boundary between two panels; withGrip draws a grip, disabled fixes it, aria-label names it.

states.name: vertical
states.description: Panels stacked; handles are horizontal rules moved with Up and Down.

states.name: dragging
states.description: While a handle is dragged: color.border.focus.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on a handle: color.border.focus and a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A handle that cannot move: no pointer events, out of the tab order.

accessibility: Each handle is a focusable role="separator" (window splitter pattern) with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax giving the size of the panel before it, and aria-controls naming that panel.

Arrow keys move the handle by keyboardStep percent (Left/Right in a horizontal group, mirrored in right-to-left; Up/Down in a vertical one); Home and End take the panel to its minimum and maximum; Enter collapses and restores a collapsible panel.
Name each handle with aria-label ("Resize sidebar"); aria-orientation is that of the rule (vertical in a horizontal group).
Dragging moves focus to the handle, so keyboard and pointer use the same element. The hit area is wider than the rule (size.track on each side).
